modelsWithoutRestaurantId.Restaurant: Tenant root. The row is the tenant, so it has no parent restaurantId. Row-level security matches Restaurant.id to app.tenant_id.
modelsWithoutRestaurantId.Plan: Platform catalog. Plans are global, not owned by a single restaurant row.
modelsWithoutRestaurantId.PlatformUser: Platform operator identity. Separate from tenant User rows.
modelsWithoutRestaurantId.PlatformAuditLog: Append-only log of platform operator actions.
modelsWithoutRestaurantId.TenantSupportSession: Platform-issued support login. Scoped by subjectRestaurantId, not restaurantId.
